arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" group by h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID" having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")
select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on upper(trim(c."ACCT_CD"))=upper(trim(l."ACCT_CD")) where c."ACCT_CD" is null

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT")
